steps.text: lucid-advancements: the vanilla advancements bind opens AdvancementsScreen, whose init the mod's mixin replaces with LucidAdvancementsScreen
lucid-advancements: the top bar registers a settings button, a tracked-filter button and then the search box, and nothing takes the initial focus, so Tab reaches the search box on the third press
lucid-advancements: type the pinyin of 石器时代 (shi qi shi dai), the story tab's mine_stone advancement; a non-empty query makes the screen search every tab
